g.text: REGULATED 5 V BENCH INPUT - 8 A SOURCE ALLOCATION - NO BATTERY CHARGER

g.desc: REGULATED 5 V BENCH INPUT - 8 A SOURCE ALLOCATION - NO BATTERY CHARGER

g.text: First bench use: current-limited 5 V source. Four regulated isolated 12 V outputs replace GAPTEC modules AND their 200-ohm loads.

g.desc: First bench use: current-limited 5 V source. Four regulated isolated 12 V outputs replace GAPTEC modules AND their 200-ohm loads.

g.text: Two 3.3 V banks are separate outputs. Total input power remains limited by the actual external source; never add output nameplate ratings.

g.desc: Two 3.3 V banks are separate outputs. Total input power remains limited by the actual external source; never add output nameplate ratings.

g.text: No raw 1S cell: R3M/TMR modules need >=4.5 V at pins.

g.desc: No raw 1S cell: R3M/TMR modules need >=4.5 V at pins.

g.text: Use current-limited regulated5V bench source, nominal8A.

g.desc: Use current-limited regulated5V bench source, nominal8A.

g.text: No reverse-polarity or USB negotiation circuit is included.

g.desc: No reverse-polarity or USB negotiation circuit is included.

g.text: Four-channel planning draw5.53A; verify startup/cable losses.

g.desc: Four-channel planning draw5.53A; verify startup/cable losses.

g.text: All branch nameplates simultaneously exceed the source budget.

g.desc: All branch nameplates simultaneously exceed the source budget.

g.text: No 200-ohm preload. Each output remains isolated.

g.desc: No 200-ohm preload. Each output remains isolated.

g.text: R3M isolation test voltage is NOT a medical/working-voltage approval.

g.desc: R3M isolation test voltage is NOT a medical/working-voltage approval.

g.text: No input-output EMI capacitor is populated.

g.desc: No input-output EMI capacitor is populated.

g.text: Verify startup and fuse coordination on the assembled prototype.

g.desc: Verify startup and fuse coordination on the assembled prototype.

g.text: 3.3 V banks: fixed PWM, enabled when their input fuse is powered.

g.desc: 3.3 V banks: fixed PWM, enabled when their input fuse is powered.

g.text: These supply primary-side SignalGen power; they are NOT isolated.

g.desc: These supply primary-side SignalGen power; they are NOT isolated.

g.text: Two banks must never be connected in parallel.

g.desc: Two banks must never be connected in parallel.

g.text: AUX feeds monitor-power boards;4A allocation total,not per channel.

g.desc: AUX feeds monitor-power boards;4A allocation total,not per channel.

g.text: No purchased battery or measured runtime is claimed.

g.desc: No purchased battery or measured runtime is claimed.
